entries.bf5ac44f9f90f91a: This division manufactures and sells automotive filters. In Japan, it is focusing on expanding sales of filters for large vehicles, high-performance oil filters and press parts; for exports, it sells its own brand "VIC" for Japanese cars overseas. The affiliated company Fujipack Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing and selling packing materials. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥7,771 million.
